explicitly_not_downloaded.reason: The frozen adapter uses the existing RGB-only BaseDepth and calibrated source/target cameras; DUSt3R would change two variables and official eval would leak target frames.

The official ViewCrafter checkpoint is loaded strictly and contains the text/image encoder parameters. The adapter instantiates OpenCLIP with pretrained=None and then loads the official checkpoint, avoiding a redundant network download.

The first full run proved vanilla attention OOM. The official dependency is optional and its historical wheel has uncertain RTX 5080 support; PyTorch 2.7 native SDPA provides the same unmasked spatial attention contract without another download.

download_horizon_conclusion: The only network asset required by the frozen public-pretrained decision tree was downloaded and verified. ViewCrafter then failed the 14-val absolute RGB gates, so generated-depth, held-out test, P01 and Gaussian Spawn were short-circuited. No additional model or dataset download is justified until a trainable multiview-prior protocol is frozen.
